changelog: v0.6.1: Native controller support + remapping (dead-zone 0.2, Controls/rebind overlay in Options, tool-switch V / D-pad Left, mouse-wheel weapon cycle, slide-as-crouch). Zombies Town remake: same 1:1 layout, all-original Forgefall contents, 6 enterable-interior buildings, 89 interior props, 73 street dressing. New Factory map for TDM (56x56 m). Cinder City upgraded: 24 buildings render Kenney City Kit GLBs (CC0) scaled to exact gameplay volumes, collision unchanged. Prices/rules unchanged.
